label: Market Close
headline: CPI +0.4%, core 0.3%, 2y +17bp, 10y 4.98%, 10y auction tails 1bp, S&P -0.4%, CoreWeave +1.7% AH
stance: Core CPI hit Waller's 50bp line and the front end repriced: 2y +17bp, December hike fully priced. Equities gave back a sixth of Monday's rally.

scorecard.call: Morning: core 0.3% or more meets Waller's 50bp threshold; consensus 0.2%.
scorecard.actual: Core printed 0.3%, headline 0.4% vs 0.3%. 50bp odds about 10% to 14% by the close, from about 1%.

scorecard.call: Morning: $42bn 10y at 1pm; watch the indirect take, not the yield.
scorecard.actual: Indirects 61.2%, from 80.3% last month. 5.020% stop, 1bp tail, bid-to-cover 2.46 vs 2.77.

scorecard.call: Morning: CoreWeave after the close; backlog and financing terms matter more than the quarter.
scorecard.actual: Backlog about $132.5bn, ahead of consensus. Funding via secured loans and about $9bn of prepayments, no unsecured debt.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Bear flattener Tuesday: 2y +17bp to 4.73%, its biggest one-day jump since April 2025. 10y topped 5% intraday.
Logan Tuesday: at least two more 25bp hikes needed. Bowman: CPI suggests inflation pressures may persist.
Gold -2.6% and the dollar up against every G10 currency Tuesday. Oil fell on Iran talks and did not offset the rates move.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Tech -1.4%, financials +0.5% Tuesday. Six sectors fell, five rose.
Nasdaq 100 hit about 27,400 intraday, then closed off the lows. Russell 2000 lagged with the front end.
Futures +0.2% S&P, +0.4% Nasdaq 100 at ~6pm ET Tuesday.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: IG and HY spread marks run to Monday; Tuesday's 17bp front-end move is not in them yet.

items.head: CoreWeave beats, raises 2026; +1.7% after hours
items.body: Revenue $3.66bn vs $3.55bn est; 2026 guide $13.0-13.3bn. Shares +5.7% at 4:16pm ET, +1.7% at $49.55 by ~6:15pm ET.

items.head: Gevo swings to Q3 profit; +18% after hours
items.body: EPS $0.09 vs $0.04 est; revenue $83.0m vs $56.3m est. Shares up nearly 18% after hours (5:06pm ET).

items.head: StubHub misses, lifts GMS outlook; -1.6% after hours
items.body: GMS $2.62bn, +7%; adjusted EBITDA +84% to $124.1m. Full-year GMS outlook raised. Shares -1.6% after hours (~6pm ET).

watch.head: Jobless claims, Thursday 8:30
watch.body: First labor read since the hot CPI. A low print adds to the 50bp case for December.

watch.head: $25bn 30y auction, Thursday
watch.body: After Tuesday's 10y tail and a 19-point drop in the indirect take. Long end sits near 5.35%.

watch.head: PPI, Friday 8:30
watch.body: September jumped 1.3%. Last pipeline inflation read before FOMC, Dec 9.

watch.head: Nvidia reports Nov 17
watch.body: Board probe of its CEO runs alongside the print. Results land before the AI IPO calendar opens.
